Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 of this section cites exactly one physical page, within physical pages thirteen to eighteen, of the private snapshot of the Alabama Driver Manual edition dated on its front cover, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: renewal windows, change-of-address deadlines, class weight and passenger limits, and the hands-free rules are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so no learner line copies the manual; fee amounts are treated as dynamic administrative facts.
Accuracy flags: none open; the class-of-license table on physical page sixteen extracted with its class letters in a separate run from the descriptions, and the pairing was read in printed order and cross-checked against the class definitions on physical page seventeen before any fact was taken from it.
Stability: the manual is one dated edition; any rule a later law or edition changes must be re-read from the current manual before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.
